messages.text: /reference Create an energetic, punchy Steph Curry highlight edit following the attached reference's pacing and visual style. Keep Curry's scoring plays, dribbles, celebrations, and crowd reactions; cut dead air, slow setup, and repetition. Use only the source footage, and aim for roughly 20 seconds to match the reference length.

The edit is applied. Here's what was built:

## Steph Curry 56-Point Highlight — 20s Edit

**10 rapid-cut shots** from the 56-point game in Orlando, structured as a hook → climax → landing arc:

| Shot | Time | Content |
|------|------|---------|
| 1 | 0.0–0.8s | Curry guarded by defender (hook) |
| 2 | 0.8–2.0s | Curry reacting on court |
| 3 | 2.0–4.2s | Jump shot release |
| 4 | 4.2–6.7s | Layup drive (with speed ramp) |
| 5 | 6.7–8.2s | Mouthguard close-up |
| 6 | 8.2–9.5s | Curry celebrating |
| 7 | 9.5–11.3s | Arms raised celebration (climax) |
| 8 | 11.3–13.3s | Curry gesturing to crowd |
| 9 | 13.3–14.3s | Crowd clapping reaction |
| 10 | 14.3–20.0s | Curry at game end (landing hold) |

**Style & effects:**
- **35 effects** across all shots: saturated color grade (1.25× saturation, 1.1× contrast), vignette, film grain
- **Impact hits**: chromatic aberration on opening frame, motion blur on the drive, glow on the celebration climax, brightness swell on the ending
- **4 transitions**: whipPan and impactShake between key beats for energy
- **10 camera moves**: handheld, punch-in, slow-push, drift, breathe, tilt-up, whip-shake, punch-out, pull-back

**Text overlays:**
- **"CURRY 56"** — pop-in title at 2s
- **"ORLANDO | FEB 27, 2025"** — fade-in subtitle at 4.5s
- **"56 PTS"** — gold slide-up callout at 9.5s (climax)

**Audio:** Game audio bed from the source footage with a crowd roar SFX hit at the celebration climax.
